item.title: [View Briefing] Kim Bu-kyum vs. Choo Kyung-ho: Daegu ‘Big Match’ ([뷰리핑] 김부겸-추경호, 대구 ‘빅매치’)
item.description:
Host: Ha Eo-young, political team reporter for The Hankyoreh. Panel: Attorney Kang Su-yeong, Kim Wan (team leader of Hankyoreh 21’s Coverage Team 2), and Kim Won-cheol (Washington correspondent for The Hankyoreh). (진행: 하어영 한겨레 정치팀 기자. 출연: 강수영 변호사, 김완 한겨레21 취재 2팀 팀장, 김원철 한겨레 워싱턴 특파원)

People Power Party’s Choo Kyung-ho elected as Daegu mayoral candidate, facing off against Kim Bu-kyum. Lee Jin-sook gives up Daegu mayoral race, likely to run in by-election. Democratic Party leadership gathers at Kim Bu-kyum’s opening ceremony. Jang Dong-hyuk, who refuses to resign, continues to be embroiled in the ‘lie about US trip’ controversy. The day after Jang Dong-hyuk says “Will take disciplinary action,” Bae Hyun-jin files another complaint with the Ethics Committee. In Busan’s Gupo Elementary, Park Min-shik and Han Dong-hoon meet face-to-face, while Ha Jung-woo is absent. 60 people gathered in support of Kim Yong’s candidacy, but what decision will the Democratic Party leadership make? Woo Won-shik on the Coupang controversy: “Clear interference in internal affairs”. US shooting incident sparks backlash: “Rushed 45 meters before being subdued.” The suspect, a hotel guest, was a master’s degree holder and ‘Teacher of the Month’. Tune in to today’s (April 27) View Briefing. (국힘 추경호 대구시장 후보 선출, 김부겸과 맞대결/이진숙, 대구시장 선거 포기… 재보선 출마 전망/김부겸 개소식에 민주 지도부 집결/사퇴 거부한 장동혁 ‘방미 거짓말 논란’ 계속/장동혁 “해당행위 조치” 다음날…배현진 윤리위 또 제소/부산 구포초서 박민식-한동훈 대면… 하정우는 불참/‘김용 출마 찬성’ 60명 모였는데… 민주당 지도부는 어떤 결정할까/쿠팡 논란에 우원식 “명백한 내정 간섭”/미 총격 사태 파문…“45m 돌진하다 제압”/투숙객 용의자는 석사 출신 ‘이달의 교사’. 오늘 (04월 27일) 뷰리핑 많은 시청바랍니다.)

item.title: Bae Hyun-jin: “Either Nominate No One or Support Han Dong-hoon… He’s Effectively the People Power Party Candidate” (배현진 “한동훈 위해 무공천하든 지원해야…사실상 국힘 후보”)
item.description:
Bae Hyun-jin, a lawmaker from the People Power Party (PPP) and a close associate of Han Dong-hoon, said on the 27th, “Since Han Dong-hoon, the former party leader, is effectively our PPP candidate, the party should either nominate no one or provide support for him.” (친한동훈계인 배현진 국민의힘 의원이 27일 “사실상 우리 국민의힘의 후보인 한동훈 전 대표를 (위해 국민의힘이) 무공천을 하든 지원해야 한다”고 말했다.)

Appearing on SBS Radio’s “Kim Tae-hyun’s Political Show” that day, Bae stated, “Over the past weekend, a few lawmakers quietly went to (Buk-gu, Busan) to share a meal and show support for (former leader Han Dong-hoon), and I found the grassroots sentiment in Busan to be very favorable toward candidate Han.” Han, who was expelled from the PPP in January over the so-called “party member board controversy,” is currently an independent. After registering his change of address in Busan’s Buk-gu Gap district—where a by-election for a National Assembly seat is scheduled for the 14th—he has been canvassing the area. <<> Bae added, “By resolving risks originating from the party headquarters and managing the election in a way that either withholds nomination or provides support for former leader Han Dong-hoon—who is effectively our PPP candidate—I have confirmed hope that we can reclaim Busan’s Buk-gu Gap, even though it was a district taken by the Democratic Party.” <<> Bae also said, “The second thing that surprised me was when I took a taxi; the driver told me, ‘Jang Dong-hyuk tried to file a complaint against Bae Hyun-jin, the Seoul City Party Chair, again and seek disciplinary action. Because of him, I won’t vote.’ When I said, ‘I’m Bae Hyun-jin,’ he was startled and replied, ‘If you bring down the Jang Dong-hyuk leadership, I’ll vote.’” She remarked, “It was a moment that confirmed where the anger lies among the long-time, loyal party members and supporters in Busan who have backed us for so long.” <<> Regarding PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk, who faces internal calls for his resignation amid the “empty-handed U.S. visit” controversy, Bae said, “If he just keeps a low profile now, a mood has already formed where no one pays attention to him. I’ve previously described his position as effectively vacant.” She noted that Jang’s U.S. trip schedule “should be subject to a party affairs audit” and added, “It wasn’t a small expense. Based on my experience in party roles, I estimate it could have cost tens of millions of won.” <<> Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (배 의원은 이날 에스비에스(SBS) 라디오 ‘김태현의 정치쇼’에 출연해 “(지난 주말) 의원 몇 명이 (부산 북구에) 가서 (한동훈 전 대표) 응원차 밥이나 한 끼 먹고 오자라고 조용히 내려갔다”며 “부산 밑바닥 민심이 한동훈 후보에게 굉장히 우호적이었다”고 전했다. 한 전 대표는 이른바 ‘당원게시판 논란’으로 지난 1월 국민의힘에서 제명돼 현재 무소속 상태다. 지난 14일 국회의원 보궐선거가 예정된 부산 북갑으로 전입신고를 하고 지역을 훑고 있다.)

item.title: Cho Gap-je: "Choo Kyung-ho, Yoon Gap-geun...The Entire PPP Nomination Is a 'Yoon Again' Nomination" (조갑제 “추경호·윤갑근…국힘 공천 전체가 ‘윤어게인’ 공천”)
item.description:
As Choo Kyung-ho, a People Power Party (PPP) lawmaker on trial for charges of engaging in major duties related to insurrection, was confirmed as the PPP's candidate for Daegu mayor, Cho Gap-je, CEO of Cho Gap-je.com, criticized it as a "'Yoon Again' nomination." Cho also applied the same logic in criticizing Yoon Gap-geun, a lawyer serving as defense counsel for former President Yoon Suk-yeol's insurrection trial, who advanced to the runoff of the PPP's primary for Chungcheongbuk-do governor. <<> On the 27th, appearing on YTN Radio's "Jang Sung-cheol's News Myeongdang," Cho said regarding the confirmation of Rep. Choo as the Daegu mayoral candidate: "I think it's disrespectful to the citizens of Daegu. Isn't Rep. Choo Kyung-ho currently on trial for charges of engaging in major duties related to insurrection? And then you're asking people to choose between him and Kim Boo-kyum, who has progressive leanings? How much agony must the citizens of Daegu be enduring right now?" <<> Cho stated: "Looking at the nomination process in this election, I even get the feeling that Chairman Jang Dong-hyuk is handing out nominations according to Yoon Suk-yeol's orders. In Chungcheongbuk-do, isn't lawyer Yoon Gap-geun now in the runoff of the primary? (But) shouldn't he have been subject to a cut-off?" He continued: "Didn't Chairman Jang say he was severing ties with Yoon Suk-yeol? How can he claim to sever ties while granting such preferential treatment in the nomination process? That's why this entire nomination is a 'Yoon Again' nomination." <<> Rep. Choo Kyung-ho, who served as the first Deputy Prime Minister for the Economy and Minister of Economy and Finance under the Yoon Suk-yeol administration, was the PPP's floor leader during the December 3, 2024 martial law declaration. He was indicted without detention on charges of obstructing the National Assembly's vote to lift the martial law and is currently on trial. However, Choo's side maintains that they only changed the venue for the party caucus meeting in accordance with the Assembly's controlled situation and had no intention of obstructing the vote. <<> Lawyer Yoon Gap-geun is the figure who led former President Yoon's defense team. In March, Kim Gye-ri, a lawyer for former President Yoon, wrote on Facebook to the effect that former President Yoon had encouraged Lawyer Yoon to run, stating: "In a meeting the day after the sentencing, the (former) President told Lawyer Yoon Gap-geun to run for Chungcheongbuk-do governor, to go out and fight and win, saying where else could a more suitable person be found." <<> Meanwhile, Cho described Chairman Jang's 8-night, 10-day trip to the United States as a "bizarre visit to the U.S." Cho said: "He met with a deputy secretary's chief of staff and said he met a deputy secretary, but when you look at that person's career, he was someone who actively campaigned for the Trump camp that pushed the election fraud theory. It seems he went due to some connection between Korean and U.S. election fraud conspiracy theorists, tried to meet President Trump, and when that failed, the (visit schedule) ended up in shambles." <<> Jeon Gwang-jun, Reporter light@hani.co.kr (내란 중요임무 종사 혐의로 재판을 받고 있는 추경호 국민의힘 의원이 대구시장 국민의힘 후보로 확정되자 조갑제 조갑제닷컴 대표가 “‘윤어게인’ 공천”이라고 비판했다. 윤석열 전 대통령의 내란 재판 변호인 윤갑근 변호사가 국민의힘 충북도지사 경선 결선에 진출한 것에 대해서도 조 대표는 같은 논리로 비판했다.)

item.title: Reform Party's Busan mayoral candidate Jung Yi-han attacked with foreign object during campaign, taken to emergency room (정이한 개혁신당 부산시장 후보, 유세 중 이물질 공격당해 응급실행)
item.description:
Jung Yi-han, the Reform Party candidate in the June 3 Busan mayoral election, was taken to the emergency room on the morning of the 27th after hitting his head on a flower bed while dodging a foreign object thrown from a passing car during a campaign speech. <<> At around 8 a.m. that day, during a campaign speech near Setown Town in Geumjeong-gu, Candidate Jung lost consciousness after falling and hitting his head on a flower bed while trying to avoid a foreign object thrown from a car passing on the road. After being transported to the emergency room, Jung received treatment and is reported to have regained consciousness. The driver fled the scene. <<> Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok, after concluding a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that day, stated, "One may choose not to support a candidate boldly challenging an election, but resorting to terrorism is an immature act. I hope for a speedy recovery and for the election campaign to continue." The Reform Party's Public Relations Bureau issued a condemnation, stating, "This is not a simple accident but a clear act of violence threatening the basic order of democracy, effectively an act of terrorism." <<> Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (6·3 부산시장 선거에 출마한 정이한 개혁신당 후보가 27일 아침 유세 중 달리는 차량에서 날아온 이물질을 피하다 화단에 머리를 부딪히며 응급실로 이송됐다.)

item.title: Ha Jung-woo AI Chief Resigns… 'Countdown' for Busan North Gap Candidacy Announcement (하정우 AI수석, 사의 표명…부산 북갑 출마선언 ‘초읽기’)
item.description:
Ha Jung-woo, the senior presidential secretary for artificial intelligence (AI) future strategy at the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae, expressed his intention to resign on the 27th. He is expected to embark on full-fledged preparations for his candidacy, a week ahead of the deadline next month on the 4th for public officials to resign in order to run in the June 3 by-elections under the Public Official Election Act. (하정우 청와대 인공지능(AI)미래기획수석이 27일 청와대에 사의를 표명했다. 공직선거법상 6·3 재보궐선거에 출마할 공직자 사퇴 시한인 다음달 4일을 일주일 앞두고 본격적인 출마 준비에 나설 것으로 보인다.)

A Cheong Wa Dae official stated on the same day that Secretary Ha had expressed his intention to resign to the presidential office. Secretary Ha is expected to submit his resignation and formally announce his candidacy for the Busan North Gap by-election after attending a meeting schedule with Demis Hassabis, the co-founder and CEO of Google DeepMind, known as the 'father of AlphaGo,' and President Lee Jae-myung on the afternoon of the 27th. It is reported that President Lee will immediately approve Ha's resignation once submitted. (청와대 관계자는 이날 하 수석이 청와대에 사의를 표했다고 밝혔다. 하 수석은 이날 오후 ‘알파고의 아버지’로 불리는 데미스 하사비스 구글 딥마인드 공동 창업자 겸 대표(CEO)와 이재명 대통령의 접견 일정에 배석한 뒤 사표를 제출하고 부산 북갑 보궐선거 출마를 공식화할 전망이다. 이 대통령은 하 수석이 사직서를 제출하면 즉시 재가할 것으로 알려졌다.)

The Democratic Party of Korea plans to hold a talent recruitment ceremony on the 29th. Democratic Party Representative Jung Cheong-rae met with Secretary Ha the previous day and had dinner for about two hours, persuading him to run. (더불어민주당은 오는 29일께 인재영입식을 열 방침이다. 정청래 민주당 대표는 전날 하 수석을 만나 2시간가량 저녁 식사를 하며 출마를 설득했다.)

Representative Jung revealed this at a field supreme council meeting held in Anseong, Gyeonggi Province on the 27th, saying, “I persuaded him to come to the National Assembly to complete the design of one of the top three AI powers through legislation. I think he might have made a final decision overnight. I believe I will be able to deliver good news to all of you.” Currently, independent former People Power Party leader Han Dong-hoon and former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-sik, affiliated with the People Power Party, have expressed their intentions to run in Busan North Gap. (정 대표는 이날 경기 안성에서 열린 현장 최고위원회의에서 이런 사실을 밝히고 “인공지능 3대 강국 설계를 국회로 와서 입법으로 완성해달라고 설득했다. (하 수석이) 밤새 최종 결심을 하지 않았을까 생각이 든다. 아마도 좋은 소식을 여러분께 전할 수 있을 것이라 생각한다”고 말했다. 현재 부산 북갑에는 무소속인 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표, 국민의힘 소속인 박민식 전 국가보훈부 장관 등이 출마 의사를 밝힌 상태다.)

Spokesperson Jeon Eun-su also expressed his intention to resign on the same day. Spokesperson Jeon is expected to run in the by-election for Asan-eul, South Chungcheong Province, which became vacant due to the resignation of Chief of Staff for Policy Kang Hoon-sik from his legislative seat. (전은수 대변인도 이날 사의를 표명했다. 전 대변인은 강훈식 대통령비서실장 의원직 사퇴로 공석이 된 충남 아산을 보궐선거에 출마할 것으로 관측된다.)

Reporter Go Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Core of Panmunjom Declaration is Inter-Korean Coexistence and Prosperity...An Inevitable Future We Must Pursue" (이 대통령 “판문점 선언 핵심은 남북 공존·번영…반드시 가야 할 미래”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 27th, "Ending war, establishing a permanent peace regime, and achieving coexistence and prosperity between the two Koreas are the core spirit of the Panmunjom Declaration and the future we must inevitably pursue." (이재명 대통령이 27일 “전쟁 종식과 항구적 평화체제, 남북의 공존과 번영은 판문점 선언의 핵심 정신이자 우리가 반드시 가야 할 미래”라고 말했다.)

In a congratulatory speech at the ceremony marking the 8th anniversary of the April 27 Panmunjom Declaration, President Lee said, "Our government will unwaveringly push forward with the 'Policy for Peaceful Coexistence on the Korean Peninsula.'" The speech was read on his behalf by Senior Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo. (이 대통령은 이날 4·27 판문점선언 8주년 기념식에서 축사를 통해 “우리 정부는 ‘한반도 평화공존 정책’을 흔들림 없이 추진해 나갈 것”이라며 이같이 말했다. 축사는 홍익표 청와대 정무수석이 대독했다.)

President Lee stated, "We will proactively take measures we can initiate first to restore trust between the two Koreas and achieve peace on the Korean Peninsula," adding, "We expect North Korea to trust the sincerity of our government and respond accordingly." (이 대통령은 “남북 간 신뢰 회복과 한반도 평화를 위해 우리가 먼저 할 수 있는 조치들은 주도적으로 취해나가겠다”며 “북측도 우리 정부의 진정성을 믿고 호응해 오길 기대한다”고 했다.)

President Lee remarked, "Eight years ago today, spring was fully in the air on the Korean Peninsula. There was an overflow of hope that a new era of peace and prosperity would finally dawn on the Korean Peninsula, which had long been marked by antagonism and conflict. However, regrettably, that promise was not kept. The future of peace and prosperity has not yet arrived, and the two Koreas are blocked by a cold and high wall of 'hostile two-state relations.'" (이 대통령은 “8년 전 오늘은 한반도에 봄기운이 완연했다. 오랜 반목과 갈등을 지속해 온 한반도에도 드디어 평화와 번영의 새 시대가 열릴 것이라는 기대로 넘쳐났다”며 “그러나 아쉽게도 그 약속은 지켜지지 못했다. 평화와 번영의 미래는 아직 오지 못했고, 남과 북 사이는 ‘적대적 두 국가’라는 차갑고 높다란 벽에 막혀 있다”고 했다.)

President Lee emphasized, "Nevertheless, it is the destiny of both Koreas to make the flowers of peace bloom on this land of severance and hostility, because war and confrontation lead not to coexistence but to mutual destruction." (이 대통령은 “그럼에도 불구하고, 단절과 적대의 땅에 평화의 꽃을 피워야 하는 것은 남북 모두의 숙명”이라며 “전쟁과 대결은 공존이 아닌 공멸이기 때문”이라고 강조했다.)

President Lee said, "Since its inauguration, the government of national sovereignty has made peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula its top policy priority and has taken preemptive measures to restore trust between the two Koreas," adding, "It has also clearly stated its principles: respecting North Korea's system, not pursuing absorption-based unification, and refraining from all hostile acts." (이 대통령은 “국민주권정부는 출범 이래 한반도의 평화적 공존을 최우선 정책목표로 삼고, 남북 간 신뢰 회복을 위한 선제적 조치들을 취해왔다”며 “북측의 체제를 존중하며, 흡수통일을 추구하지 않으며, 일체의 적대행위를 하지 않는다는 원칙도 분명히 밝혀 왔다”고 말했다.)

President Lee stated, "Even after a long winter, spring eventually comes," and "I firmly believe that if we steadily build efforts toward peaceful coexistence and shared growth, one step at a time, with the attitude of 'building a mountain by piling up soil,' a full-fledged spring will return to the Korean Peninsula." (이 대통령은 “겨울이 길어도 끝내 봄은 온다”며 “‘적토성산(흙을 쌓아 산을 만든다)’의 자세로 평화공존과 공동성장을 향한 노력을 하나씩 쌓아간다면 완연한 봄이 한반도에 다시 찾아올 것이라 굳게 믿는다”고 말했다.)

The April 27 Panmunjom Declaration is the inter-Korean summit agreement announced by then-President Moon Jae-in and North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un on April 27, 2018, at the Peace House in Panmunjom. Through this declaration, the two leaders proclaimed the realization of a nuclear-free Korean Peninsula, the declaration of an end to the war within the year, the establishment of a joint inter-Korean liaison office in Kaesong, and family reunions for separated relatives. (4·27 판문점 선언은 문재인 당시 대통령과 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 2018년 4월27일 판문점 평화의 집에서 발표한 남북정상회담 합의문이다. 두 정상은 이 선언을 통해 핵 없는 한반도 실현, 연내 종전 선언, 남북공동연락사무소 개성 설치, 이산가족 상봉 등을 천명했다.)

item.description:

The 10th constitutional amendment is set to be voted on at a plenary session of the National Assembly on the 7th of next month, but the People Power Party is opposing it as a party policy, arguing against holding the "June 3 local elections and the constitutional amendment vote simultaneously." <<> Speaker Woo said to the People Power Party, "On that night, 18 People Power Party lawmakers rushed to the National Assembly and participated in the vote to demand the lifting of martial law, and Representative Leader Jang Dong-hyuk himself also voted in favor, didn't he?" adding, "If you block until the end a constitutional amendment that would prevent even the dream of illegal emergency martial law, I hope you deeply consider who will believe your sincerity in opposing the December 3 martial law." He then said, "If this opportunity for constitutional amendment, which has come after 39 years, is blocked by party policy and fails, all responsibility must fall on the People Power Party." <<> Speaker Woo urged the People Power Party leadership and lawmakers, "Joining this constitutional amendment is the path to escaping the insurrection frame and being reborn as a healthy conservative party," and "At the very least, you should allow People Power Party lawmakers to vote on the constitutional amendment in the plenary session according to their own conscience and convictions." <<> Earlier, 187 lawmakers from both the ruling and opposition parties, excluding the People Power Party, proposed an amendment that adds to the preamble of the constitution the content of inheriting the democratic ideals of the "Busan-Masan Democratic Uprising" and the "May 18 Democratization Movement" alongside the April 19 Revolution, and strengthens the National Assembly's control over martial law by requiring the president to seek immediate approval from the National Assembly when declaring martial law. <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (우원식 국회의장이 27일 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 “국민의힘이 개헌에 반대하는 진짜 이유가 뭐냐”며 “혹자는 개헌을 가장 싫어하는 세력이 ‘윤어게인’ 아니냐고 반문하고, 국민의힘 지도부가 ‘윤어게인’에 묶여 있다는 지적도 있다”고 말했다. 제10차 헌법 개정안은 다음달 7일 국회 본회의 의결을 앞두고 있으나, 국민의힘은 ‘6·3지방선거와 개헌 투표 동시실시’를 당론으로 반대하고 있다.)

item.title: Korea-Australia Foreign Ministers to Meet on 30th…“Strengthen Joint Response to Energy Security Crisis” (한국-호주 외교장관 30일 회담…“에너지 안보 위기 등 공동대응 강화”)
item.description:
Foreign Minister Cho Hyun and Australian Foreign Minister Penny Wong will discuss responses to the energy security crisis amid the Middle East war situation and defense cooperation. (조현 외교부 장관과 페니 웡 오스트레일리아(호주) 외교장관이 중동 전쟁 상황에서 에너지 안보 위기 대응과 방산 협력 등을 논의한다.)

According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on the 27th, Minister Cho plans to hold a Korea-Australia foreign ministers' meeting in Seoul on the 30th with Minister Wong to consult on key bilateral issues and common interests, including high-level exchanges, economic security, defense and defense industry, and regional situations. (27일 외교부에 따르면 조 장관은 오는 30일 서울에서 웡 장관과 한국-호주 외교장관 회담을 열고 고위급 교류, 경제안보, 국방·방산, 지역 정세 등 양국 주요 현안과 공동 관심사에 대해 협의할 예정이다.)

This meeting takes place about a month after the two ministers held a phone call on the 16th of last month regarding the situation in the Middle East. During that call, both sides discussed energy issues arising from the Middle East situation. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that in the meeting, the two ministers are expected to “reaffirm their willingness to cooperate in responding to common challenges, such as the recent Middle East situation and the energy security crisis, and extensively discuss ways to deepen cooperation in other areas, including defense and the defense industry.” (이번 회담은 두 장관이 지난달 16일 통화에서 중동 상황에 따른 한 이후 한 달여 만에 개최된다. 당시 통화에서 양측은 중동 상황에 따른 에너지 문제 등을 논의한 바 있다. 외교부는 두 장관이 회담에서 “최근 중동 상황 및 에너지 안보 위기 등 공동의 도전과제 대응을 위한 협력 의지를 재확인하고, 국방·방산 등 여타 분야에서의 협력 심화 방안에 대해서도 폭넓게 논의할 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

Minister Penny Wong, in a statement released through the Australian Embassy in Seoul on this day, said she will visit South Korea, China, and Japan this week “as part of efforts to strengthen joint energy security.” Minister Wong stated, “South Korea is an important supplier of refined products such as diesel, gasoline, and jet fuel to Australia,” and added, “Australia will work with partners around the world to secure necessary supplies like diesel, gasoline, and fertilizer, and ensure that Australia is prioritized as a reliable energy partner.” (페니 웡 장관은 이날 주한호주대사관을 통해 낸 발표문을 통해 “공동의 에너지 안보 강화를 위한 노력의 일환”으로 이번주 한국과 중국, 일본을 방문한다고 밝혔다. 웡 장관은 “한국은 호주의 중요한 디젤, 휘발유, 항공유 등 정유 제품 공급국”이라며 “호주는 디젤, 휘발유, 비료 등 필요한 공급 물자를 확보하고 신뢰할 수 있는 에너지 파트너로서 호주가 우선적으로 고려될 수 있도록 전 세계 파트너와 협력할 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

Amid the U.S.-Israel-Iran war and the prolonged blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, the importance of fuels produced by South Korea’s refining industry is being highlighted. (미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁과 호르무즈해협 봉쇄 장기화 속에 한국 정유업계가 생산하는 연료의 중요성이 부각되고 있다.)

Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kang Hoon-sik Urges Political Neutrality for Public Officials…"Strictly Prohibits Election Involvement" (강훈식, 공직자 정치 중립 당부…“선거관여 행위 엄격히 금지”)
item.description:
Kang Hoon-sik, the presidential chief of staff, urged all public officials, including those at the Blue House and state ministers, to maintain political neutrality ahead of the June 3 local elections on the 27th. (강훈식 대통령비서실장이 27일 6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 청와대는 물론 국무위원 등 모든 공직자의 정치적 중립 준수를 당부했다.)

Vice spokesperson Ahn Gwi-ryeong reported that Chief Kang held a meeting of senior presidential secretaries chaired by the chief of staff and pointed out that "public officials' involvement in elections could undermine the fairness of elections and public trust, so all actions that could influence elections must be strictly prohibited." He also asked relevant agencies, including the police and the Blue House’s civil affairs office, to thoroughly manage and inspect to prevent any election law violations by public officials. (강 비서실장은 이날 비서실장 주재 수석보좌관회의를 개최하고 “공직자의 선거 관여 행위는 선거의 공정성과 국민 신뢰를 훼손할 수 있다며, 선거에 영향을 미칠 수 있는 일체의 행위를 엄격히 금해야 한다”고 지적했다고 안귀령 부대변인이 전했다. 아울러 청와대 민정수석실을 포함해 경찰 등 관계기관에 공직자의 선거법 위반 행위가 발생하지 않도록 철저한 관리와 점검을 당부했다.)

In addition, the meeting reviewed market conditions due to the prolonged wars between the U.S. and Israel-Iran. During a recent inspection by the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, 32 syringe and needle distributors were found guilty of hoarding. In a nationwide inspection of gas stations led by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, 99 cases of violations, including stockpiling and selling counterfeit oil, were confirmed. Chief Kang stated, "We will continue to strengthen inspections of unfair practices exploiting crisis situations, and we will respond strongly to violations with swift investigations, strict penalties, and maximum administrative sanctions." (이 밖에도 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 장기화로 인한 시장 상황도 점검했다. 최근 식품의약품안전처 점검에서 주사기·주사침 유통업체 32곳이 매점매석 혐의로 적발됐고, 산업통상부를 중심으로 한 전국 주유소 대상 점검에서도 사재기와 가짜 석유 판매 등 99건의 위반 사례가 확인됐다. 강 실장은 “위기 상황을 악용한 불공정 행위에 대한 점검을 지속 강화하고, 위반 행위에 대해서는 신속한 수사와 엄정한 처벌, 최대 수준의 행정 제재 등 강력히 대응해 나가겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Photo] I Asked AI About Ha Jung-woo's Run in Busan North Gap… ([포토] 하정우 부산 북갑 출마 AI한테 물었더니…)
item.description:
It has been reported that Ha Jung-woo, the presidential secretary for AI future planning at the Blue House, will announce his intention to run as the Democratic Party of Korea candidate in the June 3 by-election for the Busan North Gap National Assembly seat this week. (하정우 청와대 에이아이(AI)미래기획수석이 이번주 6·3 국회의원 부산 북갑 보궐선거 더불어민주당 후보 출마 의사를 밝힐 것으로 알려졌다.)

Secretary Ha is expected to announce his position after finishing the meeting between President Lee Jae-myung and Demis Hassabis, CEO of Google DeepMind, on the 27th. Under the Public Official Election Act, public officials wishing to run in the June 3 by-election must resign by May 4, 30 days before the election. (하 수석은 27일 이재명 대통령과 데미스 허사비스 구글 딥마인드 최고경영자(CEO)의 면담 행사를 마치고 입장을 밝힐 것으로 보인다. 공직선거법상 6·3 재보궐선거에 출마하려는 공직자는 선거 30일 전인 5월4일까지 사퇴해야 한다.)

Busan North Gap fell vacant when Democratic Party lawmaker Jeon Jae-soo ran for Busan mayor. In the opposition bloc, former People Power Party leader Han Dong-hoon and former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-sik have already declared their candidacies. If Secretary Ha enters the race, a three-way contest among the Democratic Party, People Power Party, and independent candidates is expected. Meanwhile, presidential spokesperson Jeon Eun-soo is also expected to run in the by-election for the Asan-eul constituency in South Chungcheong, which has been vacant since last June following the resignation of Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik. (부산 북갑은 전재수 더불어민주당 의원의 부산시장 출마로 공석이 되면서 야권에서는 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표, 박민식 전 국가보훈부 장관이 출마를 선언한 상태다. 하 수석이 출마하면 더불어민주당·국민의힘·무소속 후보의 3파전이 예상된다. 한편 전은수 청와대 대변인도 강훈식 비서실장의 의원직 사퇴로 지난해 6월부터 공석인 충남 아산을 지역구 보궐선거에 출마할 것으로 보인다.)

item.title: Kim Jong Un: "A New History of Blood-Written North Korea-Russia Friendship" … Inauguration Ceremony for 'Russia Dispatch Memorial Hall' (김정은 “피로 쓴 북-러 친선, 새 역사 새겨”…‘러 파병 기념관’ 준공식)
item.description:
North Korea held a grand inauguration ceremony for a newly completed memorial hall honoring fallen soldiers dispatched to Russia, marking the "first anniversary of the conclusion of the Kursk Liberation Operation," the Korean Central News Agency reported on the 27th. <<> Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and Chairman of the State Affairs Commission, stated at the inauguration ceremony of the "Overseas Military Operation Battle and Honor Memorial Hall" held the previous day, "We have inscribed a new history of blood-written DPRK-Russia friendship, a new history of justice achieved through blood." According to the Rodong Sinmun, Russian participants included Vyacheslav Volodin, Chairman of the Russian State Duma, and Andrey Belousov, Russian Defense Minister. <<> In his speech, Chairman Kim said, "No matter how the rules of war change, or wherever a crisis occurs, we must always respond with united strength and strengthen ourselves as a sincere, devoted, and powerful bulwark," adding, "Our resolve for the future becomes even more steadfast before this memorial hall." This is interpreted as showcasing the achievements of North Korea-Russia military cooperation in the Ukraine war both domestically and externally, while also reiterating their commitment to implementing the North Korea-Russia military alliance treaty (the "Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership") signed at the June 2024 summit in Pyongyang. <<> Chairman Kim further stated, "We fought shoulder to shoulder in the same trench for peace and sovereignty, achieving victories of key significance in preventing the revival of fascism and crushing the war ambitions of hegemonic forces," emphasizing the "strategic significance" of the operation as extremely important. <<> Russian President Vladimir Putin, in a letter read by Chairman Volodin, said, "The unparalleled valor (of North Korean soldiers) will forever remain in the hearts of all Russian citizens," adding, "I am confident that we will continue to strengthen our comprehensive strategic partnership through joint efforts." <<> It is known that, on the occasion of the first anniversary of the recapture of Kursk, North Korea and Russia are discussing the signing of mutual military cooperation agreements, including a "five-year military cooperation plan (2027–2031)," alongside grand commemorative events. Hong Min, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, stated, "Establishing a regular five-year cooperation structure means they have entered a phase of institutionalizing the alliance in the medium to long term," adding, "Given that the Russian Defense Minister visited Pyongyang, the likelihood of tangible cooperation in the military field has increased." <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (북한이 ‘러시아 쿠르스크 해방 작전 종결 1주년’을 맞아 평양에 파병 전사자들을 기리는 기념관을 완공하고 성대한 준공식을 열었다고 조선중앙통신이 27일 보도했다.)

item.title: [Breaking] Kim Young-hwan confirmed as People Power Party candidate for North Chungcheong governor… Faces off against Democratic Party's Shin Yong-han ([속보] 국힘 충북지사 후보에 김영환 확정…민주 신용한과 맞대결)
item.description:
Governor Kim Young-hwan was selected as the People Power Party candidate for the North Chungcheong Province gubernatorial election on June 3 on the 27th. Candidate Kim will compete against Shin Yong-han, the vice chair of the Presidential Committee for Decentralization, who is the Democratic Party candidate. (김영환 충북지사가 27일 6·3 지방선거 국민의힘 충남지사 후보로 선출됐다. 김 후보는 더불어민주당 후보인 신용한 지방시대부위원장과 맞대결한다.)

Park Deok-heum, chairman of the People Power Party's nomination management committee, announced the results of the runoff election for the North Chungcheong governor at the party's central headquarters that afternoon, stating that Governor Kim had been confirmed as the final candidate. In the runoff election, which combined votes from party members (50%) and a general public opinion poll (50%), Governor Kim edged out former Daegu High Prosecutor's Office chief Yoon Gap-geun. Former prosecutor Yoon, who had defeated former National Police Agency Commissioner General Yoon Hee-keun in the preliminary primary, advanced to the main primary but ultimately lost. (박덕흠 국민의힘 공천관리위원장은 이날 오후 국민의힘 중앙당사에서 충북지사 결선투표 결과를 발표하며 김 지사가 최종 후보로 선출됐다고 밝혔다. 김 지사는 책임당원 투표(50%)와 일반시민 여론조사(50%) 결과를 합산한 결선 투표에서 윤갑근 전 대구고검장을 앞섰다. 윤 전 고검장은 예비경선에서 윤희근 전 경찰청장을 꺾었으나 본경선에 올랐으나 고배를 마셨다.)

Candidate Kim had been excluded from the nomination under the "Lee Jung-hyun nomination committee" system last month, but returned as a candidate and competed in the primary after the court granted his injunction request to suspend the effect of the nomination exclusion. (김 후보는 지난달 ‘이정현 공관위’ 체제에서 공천 배제(컷오프)됐다가 김 후보가 법원에 낸 공천 배제 효력정지 가처분 신청이 인용되며 후보로 복귀해 경선을 치렀다.)

Governor Kim, classified as a "original pro-Yoon," served as a special advisor to former President Yoon Suk-yeol and drew controversy for voicing support for former President Yoon before and after the martial law and impeachment proceedings. He served four terms in the National Assembly as a member of Democratic Party-affiliated parties, held positions including supreme council member of the People's Party, candidate for Gyeonggi Province governor for the Bareunmirae Party, special advisor to President Yoon Suk-yeol's transition committee, and was elected North Chungcheong Province governor in 2022. (‘원조 친윤’으로 분류되는 김 지사는 윤석열 전 대통령의 특별 고문을 지냈으며, 계엄·탄핵 전후 윤 전 대통령을 옹호하는 발언으로 구설에 오르기도 했다. 민주당계 정당에서 4선 의원을 지냈고 국민의당 최고위원, 바른미래당 경기지사 후보, 윤석열 대통령직 인수위원회 특별고문을 거쳐 2022년 충북지사에 당선됐다.)

In the Democratic Party, Shin Yong-han, a former member of the People Power Party and current vice chair of the Presidential Committee for Decentralization, received his nomination confirmation on the 5th and has already been campaigning as the candidate. (더불어민주당에서는 국민의힘 출신의 신용한 대통령 직속 지방시대위원회 부위원장이 지난 5일 공천 확정돼 일찌감치 후보로 뛰고 있다.)

item.title: Ko Sung-kuk: "Chosun Ilbo Threatens to Kill Jang Dong-hyuk by Even Using Unidentified Leftist Critics" (고성국 “조선일보, 장동혁 죽이려 정체불명 좌파 평론가까지 내세워 협박”)
item.description:
Far-right YouTuber Ko Sung-kuk claimed that "Chosun Ilbo has started threatening People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk by even deploying an unidentified leftist critic." (극우 성향 유튜버 고성국씨가 “조선일보가 정체불명의 좌파 평론가까지 내세워 장동혁 국민의힘 대표를 협박하고 나섰다”고 주장했다.)

On the 27th, in a live broadcast on his YouTube channel, Ko said, "Today, Chosun Ilbo is still using every treacherous means to kill Jang Dong-hyuk." (고씨는 27일 자신의 유튜브 채널 라이브 방송에서 “오늘도 조선일보는 변함없이 장동혁을 죽이겠다고 온갖 간악한 수단을 다 쓰고 있다”며 이같이 말했다.)

Ko stated, "Last week, they apparently thought Yang Sang-hoon's column and Kang Cheon-seok's advice weren't enough, so this time they mobilized an external writer named 'Yoon-something'," adding, "He's one of those leftist types." He continued, "No matter how much they tell Jang Dong-hyuk to step down, he stubbornly holds on, boldly declaring, 'After the election, I will take responsibility for the results.' So now they're pressuring him through this external writer, Yoon-something," and said, "At the end of the column, they offered 'advice' to Jang Dong-hyuk, saying, 'On June 4, I will step down; even if I don't please you, please ask your supporters to give a vote to our candidates.'" (고씨는 “지난주에 양상훈 주필, 그리고 강천석 고문으로는 안 된다고 생각했는지 이번에는 ‘윤뭐시기’라고 하는 외부 필자 하나를 동원했다”며 “좌파 것들 중에 하나다”라고 말했다. 이어 “아무리 물러나라 물러나라 해도 장동혁이 꿋꿋이 버티니까, ‘선거 끝나고 내가 결과에 책임을 지겠다’ 이렇게 당차게 버티니까 이 외부 필자 윤뭐시기라는 자를 통해서 (압박하고 있다)”며 “칼럼 말미에 ‘장동혁에게 조언하고 싶다’면서 ‘6월4일 나는 물러날 테니 내가 마음에 들지 않더라도 우리 후보들에게는 한 표를 달라고 해라’(라고 조언했다)”고 말했다.)

Ko added, "It seems that after the June 3 election, they shifted their goal to killing Jang Dong-hyuk and bringing him down. Before the June 3 election, they tried to drag him down in any way, but since Yang Sang-hoon and Kang Cheon-seok couldn't do it, they even brought in an unidentified leftist critic like Yoon-something to once again threaten him, saying, 'Now promise to step down on June 4, the day after the June 3 local elections.'" (고씨는 “6·3 선거가 끝나고 나서는 어쨌든 장동혁을 죽여야 된다, 끌어내려야 된다, (이렇게) 방향을 바꿨나보다”라며 “6·3 선거 전에 어떻게든 끌어내리려고 하다가 양상훈, 강천석이 나서도 안 되니까 이제는 윤머시기 같은 정체불명의 좌파 평론가까지 내세워가지고 ‘6·3 지방선거 다음 날인 6월4일 물러난다고 지금 약속해라’ 이렇게 다시 협박하고 나섰다”고 덧붙였다.)

The column Ko referred to was published in the July 27 edition of Chosun Ilbo under the title "People Power Party Reduced to a Third Force, What Should Jang Dong-hyuk Do?" written by Yoon Tae-gon, director of political analysis at The More. Yoon wrote, "Since the expulsion of Han Dong-hoon in January this year, the People Power Party has been on a steady decline," and "The ecology of leader Jang Dong-hyuk and his circle is out of line with common sense and normalcy." He also mentioned controversies surrounding Jang's exaggeration of meeting schedules during his visit to the U.S., calling it "abnormal." (고씨가 언급한 칼럼은 27일치 조선일보에 실린 ‘제3지대로 전락한 국민의힘, 장동혁은 뭘 해야 하나’라는 제목으로 윤태곤 더모아 정치분석실장이 쓴 글이다. 윤 실장은 “올해 1월 한동훈 제명 이후 국민의힘은 쭉 내리막길이다”라며 “장동혁 대표와 그 주위의 생태는 상식과 정상의 궤를 벗어나있다”고 했다. 그는 장 대표의 방미 일정 중 면담자 부풀리기 논란 등을 거론하며 “정상이 아니다”라고도 했다.)

Recently, Chosun Ilbo has been continuing its criticism of Jang. On the 23rd, the paper published a column by Yang Sang-hoon titled "If We Vote for the People Power Party and Jang Dong-hyuk Survives, What Then?" Yang wrote, "Currently, the People Power Party is a minority in the overall public but within the party, it's not a minority faction but a union of hardline conservatives, and Jang, riding on their backs with dreams of the presidency, along with lawmakers from the Yeongnam region who see him as the better option," adding, "It's a regressive but mutually beneficial and formidable alliance." (최근 조선일보는 장 대표에 대한 비판을 이어가고 있다. 앞서 23일치에는 ‘국힘 찍어 장동혁 살면 어떻게 해요?’라는 제목으로 양 주필의 칼럼에 실렸다. 양 주필은 “지금 국힘은 국민 전체에선 소수이지만 당내에선 소수파가 아닌 강경 보수, 그 강경 보수를 업고 대권 꿈에 빠진 장 대표, 그런 대표가 차라리 낫다는 영남권 의원들의 결합체처럼 돼 있다”며 “퇴행적이지만 주고받는 이익이 있어 만만치 않은 결합이다”고 했다.)

On the 25th, the paper published a column by Kang Cheon-seok titled "Jang Dong-hyuk, Fall to the Ground and Become the Party's Fertilizer." Kang urged, "If the still-young leader Jang falls to the ground, rots, and becomes the party's fertilizer, his future will be open," calling for "his own decision." (25일치에는 ‘장동혁, 땅에 떨어져 당의 거름이 되어라’라는 제목의 강 고문 칼럼을 실었다. 강 고문은 “아직 창창한 나이의 장 대표가 스스로 땅에 떨어져 썩어 당의 거름이 된다면 그의 미래는 열려있다”며 “본인의 결단”을 촉구했다.)

Reporter Song Kyeong-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party says "MBC, apologize"... Furious over "Impeached defendant Choo Kyung-ho" closing remark (국힘 “MBC, 사과하라”…“내란 피고인 추경호” 클로징 멘트 발끈)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) demanded an apology from Munhwa Broadcasting Corporation (MBC), accusing it of "using the guise of a 'closing remark' to make an 'election-interference comment'." The previous day, Newsdesk anchors made a closing remark saying, "I want to ask what it means to put forward Rep. Choo Kyung-ho, indicted on charges of engaging in important duties for insurrection, as a candidate for mayor of Daegu," and the party took issue with this. (국민의힘이 문화방송(MBC)을 향해 “‘클로징 멘트’라는 이름을 빌려 ‘선거개입 멘트’를 했다”며 사과를 요구했다. 전날 뉴스데스크 앵커들이 ‘내란 중요임무 종사 혐의로 기소된 추경호 의원을 대구시장 후보로 내세운다는 게 무슨 의미인지 묻고 싶다’고 클로징 멘트를 했는데, 이를 문제 삼고 나선 것이다.)

Choi Soo-jin, the PPP's senior deputy floor spokesperson, issued a commentary on the 27th titled "MBC, which crossed the line as a public broadcaster, apologize." Spokesperson Choi said, "Is MBC the 'Minjoo Broadcasting Corporation (Minjoo Party election committee broadcast)?'" adding, "Yesterday, MBC Newsdesk used the guise of a 'closing remark' to make an 'election-interference comment.'" She continued, "Negative remarks criticizing a candidate of a party chosen through the legitimate selection of party members and Daegu citizens were broadcast nationwide over terrestrial television," calling it "an election remark that would suit Kim Boo-kyum's election committee spokesperson." (최수진 국민의힘 원내수석대변인은 27일 ‘공영방송의 선을 넘은 MBC는 사과하십시오’라는 제목의 논평을 냈다. 최 대변인은 “MBC가 ‘민주당 선대위 방송(Minjoo Broadcasting Corporation)’인가”라며 “어제 MBC 뉴스데스크가 ‘클로징 멘트’라는 이름을 빌려 ‘선거개입 멘트’를 했다”고 했다. 이어 “당원과 대구시민의 정당한 선택을 받아 선출된 정당의 후보를 비난하는 네거티브성 발언이 지상파를 타고 고스란히 전국에 송출됐다”며 “김부겸 선대위 대변인이나 할 법한 선거용 멘트”라고 말했다.)

The previous day, Newsdesk anchor Kim Cho-rong said, "During the December 3 martial law crisis, when the entire nation anxiously awaited the National Assembly's vote to lift martial law, the behavior of Choo Kyung-ho, then the PPP floor leader, was as shocking as the martial law itself." Then anchor Kim Kyung-ho made a closing remark: "In those urgent hours, by changing the venue of the party meeting three times and causing chaos, many PPP lawmakers ultimately did not participate in the vote to lift martial law. That night is still vividly remembered by many citizens. I want to ask what it means to put forward a defendant indicted on charges of engaging in important duties for insurrection as a candidate for metropolitan city mayor." (전날 뉴스데스크 김초롱 앵커는 “12·3 비상계엄 당시 온 국민이 초조한 마음으로 국회 계엄해제 의결을 기다리던 그때, 추경호 당시 국민의힘 원내대표가 보여준 모습은 계엄만큼이나 충격적이었다”고 말했다. 이어 김경호 앵커는 “그 급박했던 시간, 의원총회 장소를 3차례나 바꾸며 혼란을 일으킨 끝에 국민의힘 의원 다수가 계엄해제 투표에 불참한 그 날 밤은 지금도 많은 국민이 생생히 기억하고 있다. 내란 중요임무 종사 혐의로 기소된 피고인을 광역시장 후보로 내세운다는 게 어떤 의미인지 묻고 싶다”고 클로징 멘트를 했다.)

Rep. Choo, confirmed the previous day as the PPP's candidate for Daegu mayor, was indicted without detention for allegedly obstructing the National Assembly vote to lift martial law during the December 3 emergency martial law in 2024 and is currently on trial. Choo, who served as the first Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance under the Yoon Suk-yeol administration, was the PPP floor leader during the martial law. Choo's side maintains that the change of the party meeting venue was in response to the situation of the National Assembly being controlled and that there was no intent to obstruct the vote. (전날 국민의힘 대구시장 후보로 확정된 추 의원은 2024년 12·3 비상계엄 당시 비상계엄 해제 국회 표결을 방해했다는 혐의로 불구속 기소돼 현재 재판을 받고 있다. 윤석열 정부에서 초대 부총리 겸 기획재정부 장관을 지낸 추 의원은 계엄 당시 국민의힘 원내대표였다. 추 의원 쪽은 국회 통제 상황에 맞춰 의총 장소를 변경했을 뿐 표결 방해 의도는 없다는 입장이다.)

Spokesperson Choi stated, "(MBC) confined the complex situation during the December 3 emergency martial law to a simple frame and maliciously judged the actions of then-floor leader Choo Kyung-ho," adding, "Spreading uncertain negative information using the public asset of terrestrial television is an act that shakes the elections, which are the foundation of democracy." She then called on MBC to "offer a formal apology and make a promise to prevent recurrence during the remaining local election period," adding, "If there is no response to the demand for an apology, we will consider corresponding measures." (최 대변인은 “(문화방송이) 12·3 비상계엄 당시 복잡한 상황을 단순한 프레임으로 가두고, 추경호 당시 원내대표의 행보를 악의적으로 단정지었다”라며 “지상파라는 공적 자산을 이용해 확실하지 않은 네거티브 정보를 확산한 것은 민주주의의 근간인 선거를 흔드는 행위”라고 했다. 이어 문화방송을 향해 “공식적인 사과와 남은 지방선거 기간 동안 이 같은 일의 재발방지 약속을 요구한다”라며 “사과 요구에 답하지 않는다면, 이에 상응하는 조치를 검토하겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

Meanwhile, criticism also emerged within the ruling party regarding Choo's confirmation as the PPP's candidate for Daegu mayor. Kim Hyun-jung, the Democratic Party's deputy floor spokesperson, said in a briefing at the National Assembly that day, "In an election asking about Daegu's future, the PPP's answer is ultimately 'Yoon again,'" and "Candidate Choo must first clarify where he was and what he did on the night of martial law when armed soldiers trampled the National Assembly. That is the minimum courtesy to the citizens of Daegu." She also criticized, "If the PPP truly considered Daegu the heart of conservatism, they should have at least refrained from putting forward a person on trial for obstructing the martial law lift vote as a candidate for mayor." (한편, 국민의힘 대구시장 후보로 추 의원이 확정된 것을 두고 여권에서도 비판이 나왔다. 김현정 더불어민주당 원내대변인은 이날 국회에서 연 브리핑에서 “대구의 미래를 묻는 선거에 국민의힘이 내놓은 답은 결국 ‘윤어게인’”이라며 “추 후보는 무장한 군인이 국회를 짓밟던 계엄의 밤, 어디에 있었고 무엇을 했는지부터 밝혀야 한다. 그것이 대구 시민에 대한 최소한의 예의”라고 했다. “국민의힘이 대구를 보수의 심장으로 생각했다면, 최소한 계엄 해제 표결 방해 혐의로 재판 중인 인물을 시장 후보로 세우지는 말았어야 한다”고도 비판했다.)

Jeon Gwang-joon Reporter light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: 11 Local Government Heads Including Chungbuk Governor Kim Young-hwan...People Power Party's 'Incumbent Invincibility' Complete (김영환 충북지사까지 단체장 11명…국힘 ‘현역 불패’ 완성)
item.description:
The June 3 local election for Chungbuk Province governor will be a head-to-head race between incumbent Governor Kim Young-hwan of the People Power Party and Shin Yong-han of the Democratic Party of Korea. (6·3 지방선거 충북지사 선거가 국민의힘 소속 김영환 현 지사와 신용한 더불어민주당 후보의 맞대결로 치러진다.)

Park Deok-heum, chairman of the People Power Party's Nomination Management Committee, announced on the 27th at the party headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul, that Governor Kim Young-hwan was selected as the final candidate following the runoff for the Chungbuk governor race. With Kim's primary victory, all 11 incumbent local government heads of the People Power Party survived as candidates, completing the 'incumbent invincibility' nominations. (박덕흠 국민의힘 공천관리위원장은 27일 서울 여의도 중앙당사에서 충북지사 결선투표 결과, 김영환 지사가 최종 후보로 선출됐다고 밝혔다. 김 후보의 경선 승리로 국민의힘 현역 단체장 11명 모두 후보로 생존한 ‘현역 불패’ 공천이 완성됐다.)

Governor Kim outpaced candidate Yoon Gap-geun, a lawyer who served as defense counsel in the first trial of former President Yoon Suk-yeol on charges of leading an insurrection, in the runoff, which combined voting by responsible party members (50%) and a general public opinion poll (50%). Candidate Yoon had advanced to the main primary after defeating former National Police Agency Commissioner General Yoon Hee-keun in the preliminary race but was eliminated. After the primary results were announced, Governor Kim stated, "We are one under the name of the People Power Party," and "I will take the lead in uniting the hearts of supporters." Earlier last month, under the 'Lee Jeong-hyun Nomination Committee' system, Kim was initially excluded from nominations (cut-off), leading him to shave his head in protest and file an injunction with the court to suspend the effect of the exclusion decision. The court granted the injunction, allowing him to return as a candidate and proceed to the primary. (김 지사는 책임당원 투표(50%)와 일반시민 여론조사(50%) 결과를 합산한 결선투표에서 윤석열 전 대통령의 내란 우두머리 1심 재판 변호인인 윤갑근 후보를 앞섰다. 윤 후보는 예비경선에서 윤희근 전 경찰청장을 꺾고 본경선에 올랐으나 탈락했다. 김 지사는 경선 결과 발표 뒤 “우리는 국민의힘이라는 이름 아래 하나”라며 “지지자의 마음을 하나로 모으는 데 앞장서겠다”고 말했다. 앞서 김 지사는 지난달 ‘이정현 공관위’ 체제에서 공천배제(컷오프)된 뒤 삭발 투쟁을 하며 법원에 공천 배제 결정 효력정지 가처분 신청을 냈고, 법원이 이를 인용하면서 후보로 복귀해 경선을 치렀다.)

He is classified as an 'original pro-Yoon' figure. He has also been embroiled in controversy for remarks defending former President Yoon before and after the martial law and impeachment. After serving four terms as a lawmaker from a Democratic Party-affiliated party, he went on to become Secretary-General of the People's Party, a candidate for Gyeonggi Province governor under the Bareunmirae Party, a special advisor to the Yoon Suk-yeol presidential transition committee, and was elected Chungbuk governor in 2022. (그는 ‘원조 친윤’으로 분류된다. 비상계엄·탄핵 전후 윤 전 대통령을 옹호하는 발언으로 구설에 오르기도 했다. 민주당계 정당에서 4선 의원을 지낸 뒤 국민의당 사무총장, 바른미래당 경기지사 후보, 윤석열 대통령직 인수위원회 특별고문을 거쳐 2022년 충북지사에 당선됐다.)

On the Democratic Party side, Shin Yong-han, a former member of the People Power Party and vice-chairman of the Presidential Committee for Balanced National Development, was confirmed as the candidate on the 5th and is actively campaigning. Candidate Shin was recruited into the party under leader Lee Jae-myung in 2024, having previously served as head of the policy coordination support office in Yoon Suk-yeol's 2022 presidential campaign before switching party affiliation. He later served as vice-chairman of the Presidential Committee for Balanced National Development under Lee Jae-myung's government. (민주당에서는 국민의힘 출신의 신용한 대통령 직속 지방시대위원회 부위원장이 지난 5일 후보로 확정돼 뛰고 있다. 신 후보는 2024년 이재명 대표 체제에서 영입된 인사로, 2022년 대선에서 윤석열 후보 캠프 정책총괄지원실장으로 활동하다 당적을 옮겼다. 이재명 정부에서 지방시대위원회 부위원장을 맡았다.)

Meanwhile, on the same day, the People Power Party's Nomination Committee confirmed incumbent Mayor Kim Hong-gyu as the candidate for the Gangneung mayoral election in Gangwon Province. In the Gangneung mayoral race, Democratic Party candidate Kim Jung-nam and independent candidate Kim Dong-ki are also running. (한편, 이날 국민의힘 공관위는 강원 강릉시장 후보로 김홍규 현 시장이 확정됐다고 밝혔다. 강릉시장 선거에는 김중남 민주당 후보, 무소속 김동기 후보 등이 뛰고 있다.)

item.title: [Breaking] DP strategically nominates Kim Nam-kuk in Ansan Gap, Lee Gwang-jae in Hanam Gap, and Kim Yong-nam in Pyeongtaek Byeol ([속보] 민주, 안산갑 김남국·하남갑 이광재·평택을 김용남 전략공천)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea on the 23rd strategically nominated former Gangwon Province Governor Lee Gwang-jae for the by-election for the Hanam Gap National Assembly seat, which will be held alongside the June 3 local elections, and former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam for the Pyeongtaek Byeol by-election. Former Blue House spokesperson Kim Nam-kuk was confirmed as the candidate for Ansan Gap. (더불어민주당이 23일 6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 경기 하남갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 이광재 전 강원지사를, 경기 평택을 재선거에 김용남 전 의원을 각각 전략공천했다. 경기 안산갑 후보로는 김남국 전 청와대 대변인이 확정됐다.)

Senior spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun stated that the DP made this decision during a closed-door Supreme Council meeting that afternoon. The Hanam Gap by-election is taking place due to lawmaker Choo Mi-ae's candidacy for Gyeonggi Province governor, while the Pyeongtaek Byeol by-election is held after former DP lawmaker Lee Byeong-jin's election was invalidated due to violations of the Public Official Election Act. item.title: Foreign Ministry's Practical Cooperation Team Launched to Implement Follow-up Measures from Korea-India Summit (한-인도 정상회담 후속조치 이행 맡을 외교부 실질협력팀 출범)
item.description:
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs launched the "Korea-India Practical Cooperation Team" (TF) on the 27th to oversee follow-up measures from the summit between President Lee Jae-myung and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. (외교부가 이재명 대통령과 나렌드라 모디 인도 총리의 정상회담 후속 조처를 맡을 ‘한-인도 실질협력팀’(TF)을 27일 출범시켰다.)

Through the establishment of this practical cooperation team, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that it will systematically and swiftly implement agreed-upon outcomes from the Korea-India summit, including cooperation in economy, culture, people-to-people exchanges, and collaboration with local governments. President Lee paid a state visit to India from the 19th to the 21st, and after holding a summit with Prime Minister Modi, both sides agreed to elevate bilateral relations to an entirely new level. (외교부는 이번 실질협력팀 신설을 통해 한-인도 정상회담에서 경제, 문화, 인적교류, 지방정부와의 협력 등 합의된 성과 전반을 체계적이고 속도감 있게 이행하겠다고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 지난 19~21일 인도를 국빈방문해 모디 총리와 정상회담을 한 뒤 양국 관계를 완전히 다른 차원으로 발전시키기로 합의했다.)

The practical cooperation team will be led by the Deputy Minister for Asia-Pacific Affairs at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and will comprise eight members, including working-level staff from the Asia-Pacific Bureau, the Bilateral Economic Diplomacy Bureau, and the International Law Bureau. On the same day, the Ministry held a video conference with the Embassy in India, the Consulate General in Chennai, the Consulate General in Mumbai, related agencies in India, and honorary consuls in India to discuss specific operational plans for the practical cooperation team, implementation plans for summit outcome projects, and ways to cooperate with Indian local governments to support Korean companies' entry into the market. (실질협력팀은 외교부 아시아태평양 심의관이 팀장을 맡고 아시아태평양국, 양자경제외교국, 국제법률국 실무 직원 등 총 8명으로 출범한다. 외교부는 이날 주인도대사관, 주첸나이 총영사관, 주뭄바이 총영사관, 인도 주재 유관 기관 및 인도 내 명예영사 등과 화상회의를 개최해 실질협력팀의 구체적 활동 방안과 정상회담 성과사업 이행 방안, 우리 기업 진출 지원을 위한 인도 지방정부와의 협력 방안 등에 대해 논의했다.)

In a joint press statement following the Korea-India summit held at Hyderabad House in New Delhi on the 20th (local time), President Lee stated, "We have agreed to strengthen cooperation not only in trade and investment but also in strategic sectors such as critical minerals, nuclear power, and clean energy." Prime Minister Modi also said, "We will establish an industrial cooperation committee to strengthen cooperation on core technologies and supply chains between the two countries and initiate an economic security dialogue." This led to discussions on setting up a "Korea Desk" within the Indian Prime Minister's Office and an "India Economic Cooperation Task Force" in our (Korean) Office of the President, as well as the establishment of a ministerial-level "Industrial Cooperation Committee" as an economic cooperation platform. (이 대통령은 지난 20일(현지시각) 뉴델리 하이데라바드 하우스에서 열린 한-인도 정상회담 뒤 공동언론발표에서 “무역과 투자뿐 아니라 핵심 광물, 원전, 청정에너지 등 전략 분야의 협력을 강화하기로 했다”고 밝혔다. 모디 총리도 “산업협력위원회를 신설해 양국 핵심 기술과 공급망 관련 협력을 강화하고, 경제안보 대화를 시작할 것”이라고 말했다. 이를 계기로 인도 총리실 내 ‘한국 전담 데스크’와 우리 청와대 내 ‘인도 경제협력 전담반’ 설치가 논의됐으며, 장관급 경제협력 플랫폼인 ‘산업협력위원회’도 신설하기로 했다.)

Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party finalizes Hong Deok-hee, lawyer in 'valley murder' case, as candidate for Seoul's Guro District Office (국힘, ‘계곡살인 변호’ 홍덕희 서울 구로구청장 후보로 최종 결정)
item.description:
The People Power Party's Seoul Metropolitan Party Nomination Management Committee has finalized the decision to nominate lawyer Hong Deok-hee as the candidate for the Guro District Office. Earlier, the People Power Party had announced Hong's single nomination, but upon learning that she had defended Lee Eun-hae, who was sentenced to life imprisonment for the so-called 'valley murder case,' the party decided to reconsider the nomination from scratch. (국민의힘 서울시당 공천관리위원가 홍덕희 변호사를 구로구청장 후보로 공천하기로 최종 결정했다. 앞서, 국민의힘은 홍 변호사의 단수 공천을 발표했다가 이른바 ‘계곡 살인사건'으로 무기징역을 선고받은 이은해를 변호한 이력이 알려지자 공천 여부를 원점 재검토하기로 했다.)

The People Power Party's Seoul Metropolitan Party announced through a press release on Tuesday: "At yesterday's Seoul Metropolitan Party Nomination Management Committee meeting, we re-discussed Hong Deok-hee's candidacy for the Guro District Office and decided to maintain the original nomination." (국민의힘 서울시당은 이날 언론 공지를 통해 “어제 서울시당 공천관리위원회 회의에서 홍덕희 구로구청장 후보에 대해 재논의해 공천 원안 유지 결정을 했다”고 밝혔다.)

The Seoul Metropolitan Party explained: "The controversial Lee Eun-hae case was handled as pro bono legal representation, and the candidate provided clarification that this was based on a legal professional's sense of responsibility, ensuring that all citizens of the Republic of Korea are guaranteed the minimum basic right to defense, as constitutionally protected, when standing trial under the law." It added: "Considering the candidate's will to transform the long-stagnant Guro district into a place residents can tangibly feel, as well as the support and requests from Guro party members, we made our judgment after comprehensively reviewing the candidate's overall career and capabilities. We also decided to accept the strong requests from the Guro Gap and Eul district party chapters." (서울시당은 “논란이 된 이은해 사건은 무료 변론했고, 이는 대한민국 모든 국민은 법의 심판대에 설 때 헌법에 보장된 최소한의 기본적 변호권을 보장받아야 한다는 법조인의 책임감에 따른 것이었다는 후보자 본인의 소명이 있었다”고 설명했다. 또 “오랫동안 침체한 구로를 주민이 체감할 만큼 변화시키겠다는 후보자의 의지와 구로 당원들의 성원과 요청이 있었다”며 “후보자의 전체 경력과 역량을 종합 고려해 판단했고, 구로지역 갑·을 당협의 강력한 요청을 수용하기로 했다”고 덧붙였다.)

Hong's nomination will be finalized through a vote by the party's Supreme Council, in accordance with party constitution and rules. (홍 후보의 공천안은 당헌·당규에 따라 당 최고위원회의 의결로 확정된다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Cho Seung-rae: "Review of Kim Yong's Candidacy in Other Regions Also Difficult" (조승래 “김용, 다른 지역에 대한 공천 검토도 어렵다”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea announced on the 27th that it would not nominate former Deputy Director of the Democratic Research Institute, Kim Yong, for the June 3 by-elections for the National Assembly. (더불어민주당이 6·3 국회의원 재보궐선거에서 김용 전 민주연구원 부원장을 공천하지 않는다고 27일 밝혔다.)

After announcing the results of strategic nominations for three regions, including Gap in Hanam, Gyeonggi Province, Pyeongtaek-eul, and Ansan-gap, Democratic Party Secretary-General Cho Seung-rae responded to reporters' questions about whether former Deputy Director Kim, who was not nominated in the Gyeonggi region, could be nominated in another area. He stated, "While there were opinions from many inside and outside the party that former Deputy Director Kim should be given an opportunity due to his contributions to the party and the president, the party comprehensively assessed the impact on the local elections and the parliamentary by-elections and concluded that it was appropriate not to nominate him." Earlier that day, Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Geon-tae held a press conference supporting Kim's candidacy, stating, "Former Deputy Director Kim is not just a politician, but a symbolic figure showing how the abuse of prosecutorial power can destroy an individual's life." Many pro-Lee lawmakers and district party chairpersons had been demanding his nomination. <<> After the nomination results were announced, Democratic Party Strategic Planning Committee Chair Lee Yeon-hee stated, "I met with (former Deputy Director Kim) today and fully explained the circumstances. I expect him to make a great decision prioritizing the party over personal interests going forward." <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr ( 조승래 민주당 사무총장은 이날 경기 하남갑과 평택을, 안산갑 등 3곳의 전략공천 결과를 발표한 뒤 “경기 지역에서 공천을 받지 못한 김 전 부원장을 다른 지역에 공천할 가능성이 있느냐”는 취재진의 질문에 “김 전 부원장이 당과 대통령을 위해 기여했다는 점에서 당 안팎의 많은 분들이 기회를 줘야 한다는 의견이 있었지만, 당은 지방선거와 국회의원 재보선 전체에 끼치는 영향을 종합적으로 판단해 공천하지 않는 게 적절하다고 판단했다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “다른 지역에 대한 공천 검토도 어렵다는 취지로 이해하면 된다”고 덧붙였다. )

item.title: Google to open first AI campus outside London in Seoul… President Lee says "Basic income needed in AI era" (구글, 서울에 런던 외 첫 AI캠퍼스…이 대통령 “AI시대 기본소득 필요”)
item.description:
Google announced on the 27th that it will open an artificial intelligence (AI) campus in South Korea for the first time in the world, excluding London, UK, where Google DeepMind's headquarters is located. President Lee Jae-myung and Demis Hassabis, co-founder and CEO of Google DeepMind, met at the presidential office that day and agreed to strengthen AI cooperation between Google and South Korea's research and academic communities. (구글이 구글 딥마인드 본사가 있는 영국 런던을 제외하고 전세계 처음으로 한국에 인공지능(AI) 캠퍼스를 연다고 27일 발표했다. 이재명 대통령과 데미스 허사비스 구글 딥마인드 공동창업자 겸 최고경영자(CEO)는 이날 청와대에서 만나, 구글과 한국 연구계, 학계 등과 인공지능 협력을 강화해나가기로 했다.)

Kim Yong-beom, head of the presidential office's policy planning office, held a briefing after accompanying President Lee during the meeting with Hassabis and stated, "Google decided to open a Google AI campus in Seoul within this year to expand collaboration with researchers and startups," adding, "Hassabis also agreed to actively consider dispatching Google researchers to South Korea." Kim proposed dispatching at least about 10 Google researchers, and Hassabis agreed on the spot. Hassabis won the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for developing 'AlphaFold,' an AI model that predicts protein structures. (김용범 청와대 정책실장은 이날 이 대통령과 허사비스의 접견 일정 배석 뒤 브리핑을 열고 “구글은 올해 안에 서울에 구글 에이아이 캠퍼스를 개소해 연구자, 스타트업 협력을 확대하기로 했다”며 “허사비스는 구글 연구진을 한국에 파견하는 것도 적극 검토하기로 했다”고 밝혔다. 김 실장은 최소 10명 정도의 구글 연구진 파견을 제안했고, 허사비스는 현장에서 동의했다. 허사비스는 단백질 구조 예측 인공지능 모델 ‘알파폴드’를 개발한 공로로 2024년 노벨 화학상을 수상했다.)

Google also agreed to cooperate around the government's 'K-Moonshot Project.' The 'K-Moonshot' is a massive, challenging R&D initiative that uses AI to solve problems in fields like biotechnology, climate, and energy. Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Science and ICT Bae Kyung-hoon met Hassabis that day and signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Google subsidiary DeepMind for joint AI research, talent development, and utilization. (구글은 정부가 추진하는 ‘케이(K)-문샷 프로젝트’를 중심으로도 협력하기로 했다. ‘케이-문샷’은 에이아이를 활용해 바이오·기후·에너지 등 난제를 해결하는 초대형 도전형 연구개발 과제다. 배경훈 부총리 겸 과학기술정보통신부 장관은 이날 허사비스를 만나 구글 자회사인 구글 딥마인드와 에이아이 공동연구, 인재 양성, 활용을 위한 업무협약(MOU)을 맺었다.)

President Lee mentioned his key policy of basic income, asking, "In this AI era, isn't it time we need basic income?" In response, Hassabis "agreed on the necessity while adding that basic services like housing and education should be provided by the state, but market principles should also be integrated," Kim reported. (이 대통령은 자신의 핵심 정책인 기본소득을 언급하며 “에이아이 시대인 지금이야말로 기본소득이 필요한 거 아니냐”고 말했다. 이에 허사비스는 “필요성에 동의하면서 주택, 교육 등 기본 서비스는 국가가 제공하되 자본시장 원리를 접목해야 한다는 것도 추가했다”고 김 실장은 전했다.)

During the meeting, President Lee recalled the 2016 'Match of the Century' between Lee Sedol, a 9-dan Go player, and AlphaGo, saying, "South Korea was deeply shocked when a famous Go player here lost to the AlphaGo created by Demis Hassabis," and asked, "Now, no one can catch up with AlphaGo in the realm of Go, right?" Hassabis replied, "It's extremely difficult now. If humans and AI combine to counter AI, there might be a possibility." (이 대통령은 접견에서 2016년 있었던 이세돌 9단과 알파고의 ‘세기의 대국’을 언급하며 “대한민국에서 바둑기사로 유명한 분이 데미스 허사비스가 만든 알파고에 지는 바람에 대한민국이 엄청난 충격을 받았다”, “이제는 바둑 영역에서 알파고를 아무도 못 따라가겠죠?”라고 물었다. 허사비스는 “이제는 굉장히 어렵다. 사람과 에이아이가 합해져 에이아이를 대항하면 가능성이 있을 것으로 보인다”고 했다.)

When President Lee asked, "I often use the Gemini program, but sometimes it does things I didn't ask for. Is that a kind of bug?" Hassabis explained, "If the instructions given by what we call a 'foundation model' are not precise, it can go in a slightly different direction." He added, "When using and developing AI, proper safety measures, or 'guardrails,' must be implemented." (이 대통령이 “제미나이 프로그램을 저도 자주 활용하는데, 가끔은 시키지도 않은 일을 한다. 일종의 버그”냐고 묻자, 허사비스는 “‘파운데이션 모델’이라는 것이 내놓는 지침이 정확하지 않으면 약간 다른 방향으로 갈 수 있다”고 설명했다. 그러면서 “에이아이를 사용하고, 개발할 때는 적절한 안전장치, ‘가드레일’을 반드시 탑재해야 한다”고 말했다.)

In response to President Lee's question about when artificial general intelligence (AGI) might be achieved, Hassabis said, "Within the next five years, possibly as early as 2030, an AGI capable of performing all human cognitive abilities is expected to become visible, and its ripple effects could bring about social changes greater than the Industrial Revolution at a much faster pace." To mark the 10th anniversary of the AlphaGo match, Hassabis gifted President Lee a Go board signed by him and Lee Sedol. (허사비스는 범용 인공지능 도달 시기를 묻는 이 대통령의 질문에 “앞으로 5년 안에, 이르면 2030년에 인간의 모든 인지 능력을 구사하는 범용 인공지능이 가시화될 것으로 전망하며, 그 파급효과는 산업혁명 이상의 큰 사회적 변화를 훨씬 빠른 속도로 몰고 올 수 있다”고 말했다. 허사비스는 알파고 대국 10주년을 기념해 이세돌 9단과 자신의 서명이 담긴 바둑판을 이 대통령에게 선물했다.)

Reporters: Seo Young-ji, Ko Kyung-joo, Kang Jae-gu yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 고경주 강재구 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk Meets with Senior Figures to Seek Breakthrough Amid Candidate Disregard (후보들 외면에…장동혁, 원로들 만나 돌파구 모색)
item.description:
With about 30 days left until the June 3 local elections, Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, is facing an internal "anti-Jang Dong-hyuk" movement and has been holding private meetings with party seniors instead of visiting campaign sites to support candidates. Jang, who has dismissed calls for his resignation from within the party, appears to be seeking measures to manage the situation. However, candidates for metropolitan and provincial government positions under the People Power Party are pursuing survival strategies, such as forming independent election committees that exclude Jang. (6·3 지방선거를 30여일 앞두고 당내 ‘탈장동혁’ 움직임에 맞닥뜨린 장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 후보들을 지원할 현장 방문 일정 대신 당 원로들과의 비공개 회동을 이어가고 있다. 당내 사퇴 요구를 일축한 장 대표가 수습책을 모색하는 것으로 보인다. 그러나 국민의힘 광역단체장 후보들은 장 대표를 배제한 독자 선거대책위원회 구성에 나서는 등 각자도생 방안을 찾고 있다.)

According to a report by *The Hankyoreh* on the 27th, Jang met with former Grand National Party leader Seo Cheong-won on the 24th, Our Republican Party leader Jo Won-jin on the 26th, and former Saenuri Party leader Kim Moo-sung on the same day, in succession. It is known that Jang received advice from these figures on party management strategies. In a phone call with *The Hankyoreh*, former leader Seo said, "Before I go to the U.S., he requested a meeting, so I shared insights based on past experiences." He added, "It seems Jang is contemplating changes in party operations; he might soon reveal his plans." (27일 한겨레 취재 결과, 장 대표는 지난 24일 서청원 전 한나라당 대표와 조원진 우리공화당 대표, 26일 김무성 전 새누리당 대표 등과 잇따라 만났다. 장 대표는 이들로부터 당 운영 방안 등에 대한 조언을 들은 것으로 알려졌다. 서 전 대표는 한겨레와의 통화에서 “미국 가기 전에 먼저 요청이 와서 과거 경험을 바탕으로 얘기를 해줬다”며 “장 대표가 당 운영에 변화를 고민하는 것 같은데, 조만간 직접 구상을 밝히지 않겠나”라고 했다.)

Jang's focus on meetings with senior figures is interpreted as an effort to find a way to address the outpouring of calls for his resignation within the party, stemming from issues such as his refusal to shift the party's direction, internal conflicts over nominations, and controversy over his visit to the U.S. (장 대표가 원로들과의 회동에 집중하는 것은 당 노선 전환 거부, 공천 내홍, 방미 논란 등으로 터져 나온 당내 사퇴 요구에 수습 방안을 찾으려는 것으로 해석된다.)

However, Jang's presence in the local election scene is noticeably fading. Song Eon-seok, the floor leader, recently proposed the role of co-chairperson of the election committee to senior lawmakers like Kim Gi-hyeon, Na Kyung-won, and Ahn Cheol-soo. Yet, there are observations that their acceptance may depend on whether Jang joins the election committee. (그러나 지방선거 국면에서 장 대표의 존재감은 눈에 띄게 사라져 가고 있다. 송언석 원내대표는 최근 김기현·나경원·안철수 등 중진 의원들에게 공동 선대위원장직을 제안했으나, 이들 또한 장 대표의 선대위 합류 여부에 따라 수락 여부가 달라질 수 있다는 관측이 나온다.)

Candidates for metropolitan and provincial positions are distancing themselves from the central party as they jump into election campaigns. On this day, Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, Busan Mayor Park Hyung-joon, and South Gyeongsang Governor Park Wan-soo registered as preliminary candidates with their regional election commissions. The official candidate registration period with the National Election Commission runs from May 14 to 15, but they have already set aside their incumbent advantages early. Oh stated, "Compared to candidate Jeong Won-oh (from the Democratic Party of Korea), my poll numbers are slightly lower, so I need to work even harder." (광역단체장 후보들은 중앙당과 거리를 두고 선거 운동에 뛰어들고 있다. 이날 오세훈 서울시장과 박형준 부산시장, 박완수 경남지사는 지역선거관리위원회에 예비후보로 등록했다. 중앙선거관리위원회의 후보자등록 신청 기간은 다음달 14~15일까지인데, 일찌감치 현직 프리미엄을 내려놓은 것이다. 오 후보는 “정원오 (더불어민주당) 후보에 비해 여론 조사상 수치가 조금 떨어지기 때문에 더 열심히 해야 되겠다는 마음가짐”이라고 했다.)

The previous day, candidate Park Hyung-joon appointed Kim Moon-soo, former Minister of Employment and Labor and the People Power Party's presidential candidate last year, as honorary chairperson of his election committee, initiating a committee aimed at consolidating conservative support. A lawmaker from the Busan region commented, "Since Mayor Park was confirmed as the candidate, the conservative consolidation trend has continued, so this move is meant to solidify it." (전날 박형준 후보는 지난해 대통령 선거에서 국민의힘 후보였던 김문수 전 고용노동부 장관을 명예선대위원장으로 추대하며 보수 결집을 겨냥한 선대위 구성에 돌입했다. 부산 지역의 한 의원은 “박 시장으로 후보가 확정된 뒤 보수 결집 흐름이 이어지고 있기 때문에 쐐기를 박으려는 것”이라고 했다.)

Gyeonggi Province is also forming an independent election committee, keeping its distance from Jang. On that day, lawmaker Kim Eun-hye (from Seongnam Bundang-gu, Gyeonggi) announced on Facebook, "I propose a 'Gyeonggi Province Melting Pot Election Committee,' where residents of 31 cities and counties will serve as committee chairs." (경기도도 장 대표와 거리를 두는 독자 선대위 구성에 나선다. 이날 김은혜 의원(경기 성남 분당을)은 페이스북에서 “31개 시·군 도민이 선대위원장이 되는 ‘경기도 용광로 선대위’를 제안한다”고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Jong Un: "New History of Blood-Written North Korea-Russia Relations"... Discusses Signing 5-Year Military Cooperation with Russian Defense Minister (김정은 “피로 쓴 북-러 새 역사”…러 국방과 5개년 군사협력 체결 논의)
item.description:
North Korea and Russia, marking the "1st anniversary of the recapture of Kursk," reaffirmed their blood-alliance ties and discussed military cooperation plans, including a "five-year military cooperation plan." This is interpreted as a signal that the two countries, which have drawn closer through the Ukraine war, are seeking mid- to long-term military cooperation. While the security burden on the Korean Peninsula is expected to increase, cautious voices exist that the actual level of cooperation remains to be seen. (북한과 러시아가 ‘쿠르스크 탈환 1주년’을 계기로 양국의 혈맹 관계를 재확인하고, ‘5개년 군사협력 계획’ 등 군사협력 방안을 논의했다. 우크라이나 전쟁을 통해 밀착했던 양국이 중장기적 군사협력을 모색하는 신호라는 해석이 나온다. 한반도의 안보 부담이 커질 전망이지만, 실질적인 협력 수준은 지켜봐야 한다는 신중론도 있다.)

The Korean Central News Agency reported on the 27th that North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong Un and Russian Defense Minister Andrei Belousov met on the 26th and exchanged views on the international situation and mutual interests between North Korea and Russia. The Russian TASS news agency reported that Minister Belousov informed Chairman Kim that Russia is ready to sign a mutual military cooperation plan between Russia and North Korea for 2027-2031, but the Korean Central News Agency did not convey this content. The agency only stated that "a series of issues were discussed to further solidify, strengthen, and develop political-military cooperation and coordination between the two countries (North Korea and Russia)." (조선중앙통신은 김정은 북한 국무위원장과 안드레이 벨로우소프 국방장관이 지난 26일 면담하고, 국제 정세와 북-러 상호 관심사에 대한 의견을 교환했다고도 27일 보도했다. 러시아 타스 통신은 벨로우소프 장관이 김 위원장에게 2027~2031년 러시아와 북한 간 상호 군사협력 계획을 체결할 준비가 돼 있다고 밝혔다고 보도했지만, 조선중앙통신은 이런 내용을 전하진 않았다. 통신은 다만 “조로(북·러) 두 나라 사이의 정치군사적 협력과 협조를 더욱 공고히 하고 가일층 강화 발전시켜 나가기 위한 일련의 문제들이 토의되었다”고 전했다.)

The Rodong Sinmun also prominently covered the completion of a memorial hall marking the first anniversary of Russia's liberation operation in Kursk, in which North Korean forces participated. Chairman Kim Jong Un, who attended the completion ceremony of the "Commemorative Hall for Meritorious Feats in Overseas Military Operations" held on the 26th, emphasized North Korea-Russia relations as a "blood alliance" and the sacrifices of the North Korean military, stating in his speech, "We have inscribed a new history of North Korea-Russia friendship written in blood, a new history of justice achieved through blood." The ceremony was attended by Vyacheslav Volodin, Chairman of the Russian State Duma, and Minister Belousov. (노동신문은 북한이 참전한 러시아 쿠르스크 해방작전 1주년을 맞아 열린 기념관 완공 소식도 이날 대대적으로 보도했다. 26일 열린 ‘해외군사작전 전투위훈기념관’ 준공식에 참석한 김정은 위원장은 연설에서 “피로 쓴 조로(북·러) 친선의 새 역사, 피로써 전취한 정의의 새 역사를 새겼다”며 ‘혈맹’으로서의 북-러 관계와 북한군의 희생을 강조했다. 준공식에는 뱌체슬라프 볼로딘 러시아 하원(국가두마) 의장과 벨로우소프 장관이 참여했다.)

Experts forecast that the discussions on signing a military cooperation plan between North Korea and Russia signal a transition to an institutionalized, mid- to long-term military alliance relationship. Hong Min, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, said, "If previous (North Korea-Russia) cooperation was a short-term concept focused on Ukraine, it is now being elevated to a regular five-year cooperation structure," and "Beyond the comprehensive strategic partnership agreement signed in June 2024, there is also the possibility of moving toward a specific military operational agreement." (전문가들은 북-러의 군사협력 계획 체결 논의가 제도화된 중장기 군사동맹의 관계로의 전환을 예고한다고 내다봤다. 홍민 통일연구원 선임연구위원은 “기존의 (북-러) 협력이 우크라이나에 초점을 맞춘 단기적 협력 개념이었다면, 이제는 5년 단위 정례적 협력 구조로 격상하게 되는 것”이라며 “(2024년 6월) 맺은 포괄적 전략적 동반자 관계를 넘어 구체적인 군사운용협정으로 나아갈 가능성도 있다”고 했다.)

Specific cooperation measures under discussion range from simple exchange activities like inter-unit communication to joint ground force military exercises, naval training through Russian fleet port calls, and military education. What is concerning is defense and technology cooperation involving nuclear forces and conventional weapons. Jang Yong-seok, a visiting researcher at Seoul National University's Institute for Peace and Unification Studies, stated, "North Korea is strengthening its conventional weapons to integrate nuclear and conventional forces, and the possibility of cooperation for this is most concerning," adding, "If military exercises between Russia and North Korea occur, it could increase military tensions in conjunction with ROK-U.S. and ROK-U.S.-Japan joint exercises." (구체적인 협력 방안으론 부대 간 소통과 같은 단순 교류 활동부터 연합 형태의 지상군 군사 훈련, 러시아 함대 기항을 통한 해군 훈련, 군사 교육 등이 거론된다. 우려되는 건 핵전력과 재래식 무기를 둘러싼 방산·기술 협력이다. 장용석 서울대 통일평화연구원 객원연구원은 “북한은 핵전력과 재래식 전력을 통합 운용하는 방향으로 재래식 무기를 강화하고 있는데, 이를 위한 협력 가능성이 가장 우려된다”며 “또 러시아와 북한의 군사 훈련이 이뤄지면, 한·미, 한·미·일 연합 훈련과 맞물려 군사적 긴장이 높아질 수 있다”고 말했다.)

However, the extent of practical cooperation between North Korea and Russia remains uncertain at this point. Visiting Researcher Jang Yong-seok said, "North Korea and China do not conduct military exercises, and if Russia sets foot in this region through North Korea, it could also create a power struggle between China and Russia," but added, "There are various ways of cooperation, and it remains to be seen how much it will actually help North Korea's (defense) building." (다만 북-러 사이에 얼마나 실질적인 협력이 오갈진 현재로선 불확실하다. 장용석 객원연구원은 “북한과 중국은 군사 훈련을 하지 않는데, 러시아가 북한을 통해 이 지역에 발을 들이게 되면 중국과 러시아의 힘겨루기 현상도 생길 수 있다”면서도 “일단 협력의 방식은 여러가지이고, 북한이 필요로 하는 (국방력) 건설에 실제 얼마나 도움이 될지는 지켜봐야 할 일”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ha Jung-woo joins ‘Busan Big Match’…Han Dong-hoon and Park Min-shik’s unification emerges as variable (하정우 가세한 ‘부산 빅매치’…한동훈·박민식 단일화가 변수)
item.description:
Ha Jung-woo, the Presidential Office’s Senior Secretary for AI Future Planning, expressed his resignation on the 27th, officially announcing his candidacy in the by-election for the Busan Buk-gu Gap National Assembly seat. This has significantly increased the likelihood of a three-way race involving Senior Secretary Ha, former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-shik, who is being considered as the People Power Party’s candidate, and independent former People Power Party leader Han Dong-hoon. While the need for unification between former Minister Park and former leader Han is being raised within the People Power Party, both are drawing a line, intensifying the competition. <<> The Democratic Party of Korea is expecting a ‘mutual boost effect’ as Senior Secretary Ha, who is succeeding lawmaker Jeon Jae-soo in the district, and lawmaker Jeon, who is running for Busan Mayor, campaign together. A Busan city party official told The Hankyoreh, “If three-term lawmaker Jeon Jae-soo and the new face Ha Jung-woo, who will succeed him, run together, there could be a synergy effect.” Born in 1977, Senior Secretary Ha is a local native who attended elementary, middle, and high school in Busan. He shares a connection with lawmaker Jeon as a senior-junior relationship with a six-year gap from Busan Gudeok High School. <<> The variable is whether there will be unification between the People Power Party’s candidate and independent former leader Han. When Media Tomato asked 802 adults residing in Busan Buk-gu Gap, commissioned by News Tomato, on the 24th and 25th, “Who would you vote for in this region’s by-election?” 35.5% of respondents chose Senior Secretary Ha, 28.5% chose former leader Han, and 26.0% chose former Minister Park. If former leader Han and former Minister Park unify, the combined approval rating would be 54.5%, forming a structure ahead of Senior Secretary Ha (survey using wireless automated response method. For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website). <<> Within the People Power Party, concerned about the dispersion of conservative votes, there are calls for no nomination or candidate unification. A lawmaker from Busan said, “In Busan, the Democratic Party’s fixed vote is 38%, and the People Power Party’s is 40%, so in a three-way race, the Democratic Party is advantageous. If no nomination is difficult, there must at least be candidate unification.” Bae Hyun-jin, a lawmaker from the pro-Han Dong-hoon faction, said on SBS Radio this day, “Virtually, the People Power Party should either not nominate or support former leader Han Dong-hoon, who is effectively our candidate.” <<> However, both former Minister Park and former leader Han are strongly drawing a line on the issue of unification, raising questions about whether future negotiations are possible. Former Minister Park appeared on the Maeil Shinmun YouTube channel this day and said, “Even if the party leadership tells me to ‘unify,’ I will not comply.” He had previously criticized former leader Han as an “intruder.” Former leader Han’s side told The Hankyoreh, “Our approval ratings are rising, so unification can naturally happen through votes.” The two met at a total alumni association sports event held at Busan Buk-gu Gupo Elementary School the previous day, but only briefly shook hands without conversation and then left. Park Deok-heum, chairman of the People Power Party’s nomination management committee, said in a briefing at the party office in Yeouido, Seoul, the previous day, “Regarding additional by-elections, I personally think the principle should be a primary.” Within the People Power Party, former KBS journalist Lee Young-pung is also showing intent to run in the Buk-gu Gap election and is covering the region. <<> A Democratic Party official predicted, “If opposition unification does not materialize, we have a winning chance. In a three-way race, the approval ratings of former leader Han and former Minister Park will diverge, and the key will be whether former Minister Park holds out amid the wasted vote controversy.” <<> Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr and Koh Han-sol Reporter sol@hani.co.kr (하정우 청와대 에이아이(AI)미래기획수석이 27일 사의를 표명하면서 부산 북구갑 국회의원 보궐선거 출마를 공식화했다. 이에 따라 하 수석과 국민의힘 후보로 거론되는 박민식 전 국가보훈부 장관, 무소속 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표의 3파전으로 선거가 치러질 가능성이 커졌다. 국민의힘 내부에서는 박 전 장관과 한 전 대표 간 단일화 필요성이 제기되지만, 두 사람 모두 선을 그으며 경쟁이 격화하는 양상이다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Nominates Candidates for Three By-elections in Gyeonggi Province… Excludes Kim Yong, President Lee’s Closest Aide (민주, 경기 국회의원 재보궐 3곳 공천…이 대통령 최측근 김용 제외)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea on the 27th announced strategic nominations for three by-elections to be held alongside the June 3 local elections: former Gangwon Governor Lee Gwang-jae for the Gyeonggi Hanam-gap National Assembly by-election, former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam for the Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul re-election, and former lawmaker Kim Nam-gook for the Gyeonggi Ansan-gap by-election. On the same day, Ha Jeong-woo, the presidential secretary for artificial intelligence (AI) future planning, expressed his intention to resign from the presidential office and effectively formalized his candidacy for the Busan Buk-gu National Assembly by-election. (더불어민주당이 27일 6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 경기 하남갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 이광재 전 강원지사, 경기 평택을 재선거에 김용남 전 의원, 경기 안산갑 보궐선거에 김남국 전 의원을 전략공천했다. 이날 하정우 청와대 에이아이(AI)미래기획수석은 청와대에 사의를 표명하고, 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 출마를 사실상 공식화했다.)

Senior spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun announced in a briefing that the Democratic Party held a strategic nomination committee meeting and a closed supreme council meeting that afternoon to decide on the nominations for the three National Assembly by-elections in Gyeonggi Province. Gyeonggi Hanam-gap became a by-election district after lawmaker Choo Mi-ae was confirmed as the party’s candidate for Gyeonggi Province governor. Senior spokesperson Kang said, "Former Governor Lee is a heavyweight politician who has served as a three-term lawmaker and a metropolitan government head, with experience winning even in conservative strongholds and a deep understanding of issues in the Seoul metropolitan area." (민주당은 이날 오후 전략공천관리위원회 및 비공개 최고위원회의를 열어 경기 지역 3곳의 국회의원 재보궐 공천을 결정했다고 강준현 수석대변인이 브리핑을 통해 밝혔다. 경기 하남갑은 추미애 의원이 경기지사 후보로 확정되면서 보궐선거가 열리게 된 곳이다. 강 수석대변인은 “이 전 지사는 3선 의원과 광역단체장을 지낸 중량감 있는 정치인으로 보수 텃밭에서도 승리한 경험과 수도권 현안에 대한 높은 이해도를 두루 갖췄다”고 말했다.)

Regarding former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam, who was strategically nominated for Pyeongtaek-eul, Senior Spokesperson Kang stated, "He has a broad support base that transcends factions, giving him strong competitiveness in the main election even in tough districts." Kim previously served in the People Power Party and the Reform Party before switching to the Democratic Party. Pyeongtaek-eul now features a multi-way race with candidates including Cho Kuk, leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party; Kim Jae-yeon, leader of the Progressive Party; former People Power Party lawmaker Yoo Ui-dong; and Hwang Kyo-ahn, leader of the Liberty and Innovation Party. For former lawmaker Kim Nam-kook, strategically nominated for Gyeonggi Ansan-gap, Kang noted, "He has a solid organizational base and a deep understanding of local issues, built during his tenure as a lawmaker representing the Ansan area." (강 수석대변인은 평택을에 전략공천된 김용남 전 의원에 대해 “진영을 뛰어넘는 폭넓은 지지 기반으로 험지에서도 승리할 수 있는 높은 본선 경쟁력을 갖추고 있다”고 했다. 김 전 의원은 국민의힘, 개혁신당에서 활동하다 민주당으로 당적을 옮겼다. 평택을은 조국 조국혁신당 대표, 김재연 진보당 대표, 유의동 국민의힘 전 의원, 황교안 자유와혁신 대표가 출마해 다자 구도를 형성하고 있다. 경기 안산갑에 전략공천된 김남국 전 의원에 대해선 “과거 안산을 지역구로 국회의원을 역임하며 다져온 탄탄한 조직력과 높은 현안 이해도를 갖고 있다”고 했다.)

However, the Democratic Party decided not to nominate Kim Yong, former deputy director of the Democratic Research Institute and a close aide to President Lee Jae-myung, who had expressed his intention to run in Gyeonggi Province, for this by-election. (다만 민주당은 경기 지역 출마 의지를 드러냈던 이재명 대통령의 최측근 김용 전 민주연구원 부원장은 이번 재보궐선거에 공천하지 않기로 결정했다.)

Meanwhile, on the same day, presidential spokesperson Jeon Eun-soo expressed his intention to resign from the presidential office and is expected to announce his candidacy for the Chungnam Asan-eul by-election. (한편, 이날 전은수 청와대 대변인은 청와대에 사의를 표명했는데 충남 아산을 보궐선거에 출사표를 던질 예정이다.)

Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Kim Chae-woon, Reporter cwk@hani.co.kr (고한솔 sol@hani.co.kr 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)
